predecessors.name: Tughlaq dynasty
predecessors.text: Warangal and Telangana, held by the Delhi Sultanate's governors after the Kakatiya fall of 1323

successors.name: Recherla Nayaks
successors.text: the Telangana part of the Musunuri territories, annexed by the Recherla Nayakas in 1368

ledger.x: 1335: the Musunuri Nayaks rise at Rekapalle.
1361: Golconda is ceded to the Bahmanis.
1368: the Krishna-Godavari coast has no holder on the pages.

wars.name: Bahmani-Vijayanagara War
wars.outcome: Kapaya was defeated 'along with the forces of the Vijayanagara Empire'; he ceded Golconda and the throne of Warangal.

wars.name: Recherla conquest of the Musunuri lands
wars.outcome: Kapaya Nayaka was killed at Bhimavaram near Warangal and the Recherlas annexed his territories.

certainty.note: No boundary is on the pages; the extent is circles round the places named.
